A1.justification: Both PDFs describe UniVLG. Their main text, equations, tables, figures and complete appendices are readable and support comparison, including matching relocated material.

before.justification: v1 reports original grounding, question-answering and segmentation results, alongside ablations, generalization experiments and sensor-noise tests.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, revises several grounding scores and adds detailed ReferIt3D comparisons in Table 14.

M1.justification: The encoders, language-conditioned mask decoder, attention operations, lifting strategy and losses are unchanged. Implementation material expanded in the main text already appears in v1 Appendix A.2.

E1.justification: Dataset and task coverage is retained. LX3D becomes L3DD with the same constituent domains and Table 2 results. The AI2-THOR experiment moves from the appendix to Section 4.6; Table 14 breaks down existing ReferIt3D coverage.

E2.justification: New Table 14 compares UniVLG with ViL3DRel, CoT3DRef and MiKASA, alongside the existing comparator 3D-VisTA. ViL3DRel was previously discussed but not tabulated as a comparator. Earlier comparison tables retain their baseline sets.

E3.justification: The documented training settings, validation splits, Det/GT protocols, mesh/sensor setups and evaluation metrics are retained. Table 14 adds subgroup reporting without documenting a revised experimental procedure; the detailed implementation passage is relocated from v1.

E4.justification: Table 14 adds difficulty and viewpoint-dependence breakdowns for NR3D and SR3D, exposing performance differences hidden by aggregate scores. Existing ablations, sensor-noise tests, AI2-THOR generalization and failure examples remain; their relocation is not new analysis.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. Results remain point estimates, and the sensor-noise plots retain the same reporting practice.

E6.justification: Table 1 revises NR3D Det scores for both variants, including Acc@25 from 52.5 to 54.7 and 56.3 to 58.3. UniVLG-3D-only GT accuracy changes from 78.9 to 81.7 on SR3D and 65.8 to 65.2 on NR3D. Table 14 adds comparator and subgroup results; other matched result tables remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The query-refinement equations, mask and grounding definitions, and total-loss formulation are unchanged. Neither version adds theoretical propositions or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract and principal contributions retain the same claims: unified 2D/3D learning, benefits from lifting and pretrained features, superior mask decoding, and evaluation without mesh reconstruction or ground-truth proposals.

C2.justification: The conclusion newly states that UniVLG is designed for static scenes and identifies dynamic environments as future work. Existing failure mechanisms, generalization limitations and mask-versus-box interpretations are retained, with some repeated in the main text.

D1.justification: v3 removes v1 Appendix A.3's out-of-domain annotation procedures, mask sources, quality-control description and validation sample counts. Hardware, batch size, frame sampling, lifting probability and code-access information remain available; moving implementation details into the main text adds no new disclosure.

R1.justification: v3 adds CoT3DRef and MiKASA references and identifies the formerly anonymous dataset source through Arnaud et al. (2025). The SAMPro3D reference disappears with the dataset-description section. Positioning relative to ODIN and other central prior methods remains unchanged.

P1.justification: The main-text/appendix organization is substantially revised: implementation details and the generalization experiment move into the main text, which also gains a failure-mode subsection while retaining its appendix counterpart. The dataset-description section, appendix contents list and Impact Statement disappear, and the conclusion expands. Most retained scientific prose remains similar.

P2.justification: Table 14 is added, and v1 Table 12 becomes main-text Table 8, with accompanying table relocation and reflow. Existing figures and table designs are largely preserved. Table 2's former appendix reference becomes an unresolved '??' in its caption.

improvement.justification: The subgroup comparisons and explicit static-scene limitation are useful, but empirical traceability declines. v3 removes the out-of-domain annotation and sample documentation, while revised Table 1 NR3D Acc@25 values of 54.7/58.3 conflict with retained Table 6 values of 52.5/56.3 without explanation. These documentation and consistency losses outweigh the limited additions, although the method and most supporting evidence remain intact.
